messages.context: 首次介绍宠物收购服务
messages.text: Hey there, I'm George the Pet Collector!
messages.raw: §fHey there, I'm George the Pet Collector!
messages.gloss: Pet Collector 是职务称呼,George 是保留英文的人名。
messages.zh: 你好,我是宠物收藏家 George!

messages.context: 首次介绍宠物收购服务
messages.text: I travel the world searching far and wide for the rarest pets I can find!
messages.raw: §fI travel the world searching far and wide for the rarest pets I can find!
messages.zh: 我四处游历,就是为了寻找世上最稀有的宠物!

messages.context: 首次介绍宠物收购服务
messages.text: If you have any pets which need a new home I'd be happy to buy them off you!
messages.raw: §fIf you have any pets which need a new home I'd be happy to buy them off you!
messages.zh: 如果你的宠物需要一个新家,我很乐意买下它们!
